part.text:
Fixed in `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs:6189`: the leading NUL is now stripped before passing the path to `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, affecting both `UnixListener::bind` and `UnixStream::connect`.

Validated with the full Unix socket test suites (`uds_stream`, `uds_datagram`, `uds_socket`, `uds_split`, `uds_cred`): all pass, including `abstract_socket_name`.
